title: 4. The four-control spine (the heart of the session)
objective: Study-guide review — Study Guide — Session 2: Practical Agentic Workflow Controls: 4. The four-control spine (the heart of the session).

blocks.text: Introduce the pattern as a pipeline every agent action must pass through. Each control answers one examiner question and kills one failure mode. [SRC: design/S2_workflow_controls.md §2 Beat 3; §5 slide 6–7]
[ TASK CARD ] → [ APPROVAL GATE ] → [ EXECUTION PROOF ] → [ AUDIT TRAIL ]

rows: What is it allowed to do?
A declared, bounded unit of work: goal, allowed tools, allowed data, blast-radius limit.
A required human decision before any write, deploy, or irreversible step.
Captured evidence of the run — diffs, test output, commands, before/after — independent of the agent's own claim.
Time-stamped record linking card → approver → proof. The demo row is mutable/resettable in memory; production needs external, access-controlled, tamper-evident logging.

blocks.text: Visual (slide 6): one horizontal pipeline, four gates, a request flowing left→right; a red action that tries to skip a gate bounces back at the gate that should have caught it. [SRC: design/S2_workflow_controls.md §3.0 Governance Console]
Per-control teaching detail (with the enrichment fold-ins):

items: Control 1 — Task Card = the least-privilege boundary. Teach by what is deliberately not granted. Fold-in

blocks.text: (C3): a deterministic, version-controlled script / procedure the agent must follow is itself a reviewable Task Card — constraining the agent to a checklist shrinks its action space (directly mitigating Excessive Agency). [SRC: design/ENRICHMENTS_v1.1.md — Theme B fold-in / S2]

items: Control 2 — Approval Gate = the maker–checker control for agents. (C6) The gate is deterministic — a human

blocks.text: decision and/or deterministic checks (tests, lint, policy-as-code). Agent self-review is NOT the gate; "the AI said it's fine" is never sold as a control. An agent may draft and flag flaws pre-publish, but the gate that authorizes a state change is human + deterministic. [SRC: design/ENRICHMENTS_v1.1.md — Theme B: agent = drafts/reviews; GATE is deterministic]

items: Control 3 — Execution Proof = evidence independent of the agent's claim (diff applied, test red→green, commit

blocks.text: hash). Fold-in (C3): when configs are config-as-code in VCS, the proof is diffable — the change is the evidence. [SRC: design/ENRICHMENTS_v1.1.md — Theme B: config-as-code makes Execution Proof + Audit Trail diffable]

items: Control 4 — Audit Trail = one linked demo row tying card → approver → timestamp → proof → result. It answers all

blocks.text: three examiner questions at once, and it records blocked actions too (see Scenario B). [SRC: design/S2_workflow_controls.md §3 Scenario A step 5; Scenario B step 7]
Spoken (TH): "จำสี่อย่างนี้: ขออนุญาตทำอะไร (Task Card) → ใครอนุมัติ (Approval Gate) → ทำแล้วได้อะไรจริง (Execution Proof) → ย้อนตรวจได้ไหม (Audit Trail). ขาดอันใดอันหนึ่ง = ช่องโหว่ governance."
